Settings.Name: XP gain multiplier
Settings.Description: Scales the experience your party earns. 1.0 is the standard curve, tuned to reach level 20 by the end of the game. Below 1.0 levelling is slower, above 1.0 it is faster. Only experience earned from now on is scaled.

Settings.Name: Apply the multiplier to
Settings.Description: Which part of the 1-20 range the XP multiplier covers, judged by the level a gain starts at. The base game's own levels 1-12 and Apotheosis's levels 13-20 can be paced separately.

Settings.Name: Epic Boons need level 19
Settings.Description: PHB 2024: Epic Boon feats have the prerequisite Level 19+. Untick to be able to pick them at any level (for example for a one-shot or a high-level start).

Settings.Name: Debug logging
Settings.Description: Writes extra [Apotheosis] [dbg] lines to the Script Extender log. Turn on when reporting a bug.
